name: mdx-message-action-contract
rules: An action request records first as message.action.requested, then displays as an action_request Message event sourced by that receipt
A human verdict records as message.action.verdict.recorded, then displays as an action_response Message event sourced by that verdict
Approve, edit, reject, and respond are recorded verdicts before the deterministic gate evaluates the action payload
The deterministic gate may apply a known governed state transition; the supported transitions are Pages draft approval request and Pages approval decision
No verdict executes tools, calls providers, writes production state, spawns workers, or authorizes background work
